scope: Cloud proxy samples only. Not PS4 bandwidth, not full-package integrity. Up to12MiB total payload across3games, plus3240headerbytes.
method: One sequential 2 MiB byte range versus two concurrent adjacent 1 MiB ranges from the same approved final HTTPS URL; exact 206, Content-Range, Content-Length and equal strong ETag validated. Samples were compared byte-for-byte.
limitations: Small public samples through the development proxy, not a sustained PS4 test.
Sample hashes identify only the sampled bytes; no complete PKG was downloaded or hashed.
This does not predict bandwidth on the user’s Claro Wi-Fi or guarantee a speed increase.
